rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name plus ZIP, matched to a single account, before accessing order/payment details. It attempted to locate the specified order, then fetched the user’s three orders and correctly reported their statuses. No order-changing actions were performed, so no confirmation was needed; the agent did not execute any write without consent. When the user pivoted to checking the gift card balance, the agent provided the correct balance ($86) consistent with tool data. There is a minor quality issue: the agent stated the provided IDs didn’t match items without considering that one ID (1656367028) was a product ID present in the pending order, and it asserted exchanges require “delivered” status without explicit tool-backed policy. However, no incorrect actions or unsupported final claims were made, and the final user request (GC balance) was completed accurately after proper authentication. Hence, this meets the pass bar.
